# USE THIS MODEL

> Recommends which AI model to use for chatting, everyday coding and crazy-hard coding: the cheapest model that clears a score floor under a price cap. All settings are URL query params; there are no default picks.

## Bot endpoint

- [/api/picks](https://usethismodel.vercel.app/api/picks?chat=eci&chat_max=1&chat_min=65&code=eci&code_max=3&code_min=80&crazy=eci&crazy_max=15&crazy_min=95) - same params as the page, JSON picks. No/invalid params = HTTP 400 naming the bad settings.
- [Settings docs](https://usethismodel.vercel.app/docs) - every param, normalization, missing-data modes, price meaning.
- [Raw data](https://usethismodel.vercel.app/models.json) - normalized + raw benchmark scores, input/output USD per 1M tokens. Updated 2026-11-11T23:23:28.820Z.

## Recommended settings

https://usethismodel.vercel.app/?chat=eci&chat_max=1&chat_min=65&code=eci&code_max=3&code_min=80&crazy=eci&crazy_max=15&crazy_min=95
